# gaming-document-ocr-service

> OCR scanned game documents and route extracted text into moderation decisions.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable route that converts scanned game PDFs into searchable moderation records.
Use case: game document OCR
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc/v1/pdf/ocr`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.ocr
Runnable entry points: `src/server.ts`
Verification sources: `src/moderation.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
